title: Smart Apparel: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Prove the product with a wear trial: 20 users, 2 weeks, with wash and fit feedback.
Two different countries, two sets of rules. Pick the country first, then use that country’s list in every module. Check with a local expert.

Launch with a go or no-go rule: 50 pre-orders in 6 weeks and a passed lab test. Check with a local expert.
